body: I think the array construction can be moved below the `if (variable_expression_count == 0)` block - no need to create the array to join at runtime if the full string is const

I think this (and the const case for SLOTs) is adding the individual constants to the final compiled script, even if they're unused in the case where it just returns `constant_string`.

Would it make sense to do the `constant_string` logic in `GDScriptAnalyzer::reduce_formatted_string`, and set `p_formatted_string->is_constant` and `p_formatted_string->reduced_value` if the full string is const?  This would cause `GDScriptCompiler::_parse_expression` to return early for fully const formatted strings, and the formatted string block could then just assume the join call/array needs to be built up.
